description: This file defines a Kivy application demonstrating nested orthogonal scroll views using KV language. It includes class definitions for layout widgets, dynamic population of scrollable content, and application setup.

classes.name: HorizontalScrollRow
classes.description: Widget containing a horizontal ScrollView with buttons, representing a row in the nested scroll view demo.

classes.name: VerticalScrollColumn
classes.description: Widget containing a vertical ScrollView with buttons, representing a column in the nested scroll view demo.

classes.name: NestedScrollViewKVDemo
classes.description: Main application class that builds and populates the nested scroll view demo interface.

methods.name: on_kv_post
methods.description: Populates the horizontal or vertical scroll content after KV language processing for HorizontalScrollRow and VerticalScrollColumn classes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main application layout, populates the left and right containers with scroll view widgets.
